package probe

import "os/exec"

// The element literals elide their type: the slice and the map name a type
// that holds exec.Cmd, and no composite type holds a command (P2), so each of
// these three is refused at its type expression, the third one though its
// element writes an Env.
func compositeElided() {
	_ = []*exec.Cmd{{Path: "/bin/sh"}}
	_ = map[string]*exec.Cmd{"sh": {Path: "/bin/sh"}}
	_ = []*exec.Cmd{{Path: "/bin/sh", Env: []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}}}
}
